Package aor.proj3t.websocket

Class WebSocketSessionManager

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.websocket.WebSocketSessionManager
public class WebSocketSessionManager extends Object
WebSocket Session Manager for Real-time Communication. This utility class manages WebSocket sessions for users, providing centralized session storage and retrieval capabilities. It maintains a thread-safe mapping between user IDs and their active WebSocket sessions.

The manager supports operations for adding, removing, and querying user sessions, as well as checking connection status and broadcasting capabilities.

All methods are static as this class maintains global state for all WebSocket connections in the application.

  • Method Details

    • addSession

      public static void addSession(Long userId, jakarta.websocket.Session session)
      Adds a user WebSocket session to the manager.

      If a session already exists for the user, it will be replaced with the new session. This handles cases where a user reconnects or has multiple connection attempts.

      Parameters:
      userId - the unique identifier of the user
      session - the WebSocket session to associate with the user
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if userId or session is null

    • removeSession

      public static void removeSession(Long userId)
      Removes a user session from the manager.

      This method should be called when a user disconnects or when a session becomes invalid. It's safe to call this method even if no session exists for the given user ID.

      Parameters:
      userId - the unique identifier of the user whose session should be removed

    • isUserConnected

      public static boolean isUserConnected(Long userId)
      Checks if a user is currently connected via WebSocket.

      This method not only checks if a session exists for the user, but also verifies that the session is still open and active.

      Parameters:
      userId - the unique identifier of the user to check
      Returns:
      true if the user has an active and open session, false otherwise

    • getSession

      public static jakarta.websocket.Session getSession(Long userId)
      Retrieves the WebSocket session for a specific user.

      Returns null if no session exists for the user. Callers should check if the returned session is still open before using it.

      Parameters:
      userId - the unique identifier of the user
      Returns:
      the WebSocket session for the user, or null if not found

    • getAllSessions

      public static Map<Long,jakarta.websocket.Session> getAllSessions()
      Retrieves all active user sessions.

      Returns a map containing all user ID to session mappings currently managed by this class. The returned map is the actual internal map, so modifications will affect the session manager.

      Warning: Use with caution as direct modifications can affect the global session state.

      Returns:
      an unmodifiable view of all user sessions
